name: mathmodel-skill
description: A stateful, compliance-aware ten-stage workflow for CUMCM, MCM/ICM, and Diangong Cup mathematical modeling competitions.

interface.shortDescription: 让三类数学建模竞赛从选题到终稿持续收敛
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native mathematical modeling competition workflow that carries team decisions from problem selection through modeling, robustness, writing, compliance review, and final submission. Ten staged checkpoints, persistent state, competition-specific rules, deterministic helpers, and targeted revision keep long-running collaboration coherent.
defaultPrompt: Use $mathmodel-skill to guide my CUMCM team from kickoff to submission.
Use $mathmodel-skill to compare MCM problem choices and record the decision.
Use $mathmodel-skill to run a compliance-first final review of our modeling paper.
